scope: Creative studio projects and team capacity, web product

sources.title: Studio - Agency Project Management Dashboard
sources.creator: Dodik Danang for Korsa
sources.inspection_method: Opened individual work in Chrome, then viewed first page-exposed CDN image via browser screenshot.
observed: Narrow pale sidebar, strong black agency-operations heading.
Compact project table and team-capacity rows share the main column; a right activity column adds context.
Near-white border-defined surfaces, small colored status indicators.
adaptation: Use dense studio navigation, compact project rows and a distinct capacity panel.
Replace financial telemetry with project delivery and workload; original warm paper, ink and cobalt tokens.
sources.asset_rights: Public reference, redistribution license not established. Linked only; no third-party image bundled or hotlinked.

sources.title: Project Workspace Dashboard UI
sources.creator: Jason D
sources.inspection_method: Opened individual work in Chrome, then viewed first page-exposed CDN image via browser screenshot.
observed: Pale shell, project cards with status, progress, owners and dates.
Filter chips above project cards and separate menu grouped by status and members.
Cobalt framing contrasts with a monochrome app.
adaptation: Working card/list switch, status/team filters and visible ownership.
Keep cobalt on actions and selected controls rather than decorative framing.
sources.asset_rights: Public reference, redistribution license not established. Linked only; original HTML/CSS/SVG throughout.

selected_direction.name: Ink & Cadence
selected_direction.evidence: 由你定风格，直接完成三个案例
selected_direction.rationale: Warm paper and ink create calm editorial hierarchy; cobalt marks action, lilac marks one capacity allocation.

limitations: Concept shots are not proof of shipped usability.
Two directly relevant works inspected; not complete external product flows.
No third-party image, font or icon redistributed.
